Test Case Title: TC0001_Check the Deeplink navigation when user is logged in
Description: Validate Clicking on the Get started Button in the notification mailer should navigate them to the learing in the app
Precondition:
1.User has the mobile app installed (iOS/Android).
2.User is already logged in to the app.
3. User has received a notification mailer containing a deeplink to a learning.
Steps:
1. Open the notification mailer.
2. Click on the learning deeplink.
3. Validate if User lands in "My Space" page
Expected Result:
1. Notification mailer should contain learnings details and Get started button
2. Deep Linking redirection from Notification mailer should open the iOS/Android app directly.
3. User should land on the specific learning’s preview page in “My Space”.
Actual Result: Clicking on the Get started Button in the notification mailer navigates them to the learing in the app

Test Case Title: TC0002_Check Deeplink navigation when user is logged out
Description: Validate Clicking on the Get started Button in the notification mailer should navigate them to the log in page of the app
Precondition:
1. User has the mobile app installed (iOS/Android).
2. User is logged out of the app.
2. User has received a notification mailer containing a deeplink to a learning.
Steps:
1. Open the notification mailer.
2. Click on the learning deeplink.
3. Enter valid credentials on the login page and log in.
Expected Result:
1. Notification mailer should contain learnings details and Get started button
2. App should open and lands on the login page prompting user to login.
3. Upon successful login, user should be redirected to the specific learning’s preview page in “My Space”.
Actual Result: Clicking on the Get started Button in the notification mailer navigates them to the log in page of the app
